title: Read your own fee
lesson: Before you sign, a wallet shows a maximum fee. What you actually pay is the gas your transaction used multiplied by the price per unit of gas in that block (base fee plus tip). The fee is paid even if a transaction fails, so always keep some AVAX for gas.
task: Use the receipt of your mission 3 transaction to work out the fee you paid, in AVAX.
hint: fee = gas used × effective gas price. 1 nAVAX = 0.000000001 AVAX.
